StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is exactly what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch anywhere in it). StackType's only non-presentation readers are GetTypeForAmount (PowerModel.cs:462) and InvokePowerModified's VFX split (Creature.cs:628). Both are third-file citations not hashed by this record.

ModifyBlockAdditive.issue: The sim keys the ownership test on the BLOCK TARGET where C# keys it on the CARD's owner. DexterityPower.cs:16-26: when cardSource != null the test is `cardSource.Owner.Creature != base.Owner -> 0m` and the target is not consulted at all; only for cardSource == null (a monster move) does it fall back to `base.Owner != target`. powers.py:135 tests `target is self.owner` in both cases. Divergent whenever a card played by the Dexterity holder grants block to somebody else: C# adds the holder's Dexterity, the sim adds nothing. DORMANT -- an executed grep for cross-creature block grants in the sim finds only RampartPower (powers.py:2994-3002), which is a power and so passes card=None, taking C#'s identical fallback branch. Named trigger: porting any card that grants block to an ally or an enemy.

Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.what: Sign-aware power typing on a negative Dexterity application
guards.issue: SIGN-AWARE TYPING (PROMPT.md bug class 3). GetTypeForAmount (PowerModel.cs:460-471, a third file not hashed by this record) returns PowerType.Debuff for this power at any NEGATIVE amount, because StackType == Counter && AllowNegative. The sim has no get_type_for_amount at all and tests the static class attribute, so a negative-amount application is a Buff to the sim and a Debuff to the game. Same mechanism as audit/records/seam/power_cmd.json gaps G1 (Artifact interception) and G2 (Unsettling Lamp's doubling gate); per binding rule 3 it carries the identical verdict and the identical named trigger -- DORMANT until Malaise.cs:39 or Resonance.cs:33 is ported, the only two C# sites where a PLAYER applies a negative-amount stat power to an enemy. Re-checked for a new route and found none: the sim's negative applications of this power are all monsters targeting the player (the_lost_and_forgotten.py:54,99, lagavulin_matriarch.py:106-107), TenderPower self-applying (powers.py:2115-2116), or the TemporaryStrength/Dexterity revert (powers.py:863,937) -- Artifact needs a player-side source that exists nowhere in the game and Lamp needs `applier is player`, which none of those is. Reproduce the census with `py audit/tools/power_census.py typing`: of 134 ported powers only strength and dexterity actually flip.
